abstract: RareBurden Commons provides data-acquisition, provenance, semantic, evidence-ledger, burden-estimation, federated-analysis and release-assurance components for the Global Rare Disease Burden Initiative. Pre-v1 releases are research software and synthetic assurance infrastructure, not clinical decision-support tools or definitive global burden estimates.
description: Open, reproducible infrastructure and reference software for measuring the collective health, social and economic burden of rare diseases.
name: RareBurden Commons
